red_flags.action: Stop exercising immediately, apply ice, see doctor within 24 hours

red_flags.symptom: Knee gives out or feels unstable
red_flags.action: Stop weight-bearing exercises, use support, consult healthcare provider

red_flags.symptom: Fever with joint pain and swelling
red_flags.action: Seek immediate medical attention - possible infection

red_flags.symptom: Chest pain or severe shortness of breath
red_flags.action: Stop exercise, call emergency services if severe

general_safety_rules: Progress gradually - one variable at a time
Have support nearby for balance exercises
